source: The attention-score arithmetic is a different story. There are still 32 query heads producing 32 attention outputs. Sharing a K/V head does not erase those query-head computations. It primarily reduces K/V projection multiplicity, cache capacity, and the amount of distinct cached K/V data that needs to be supplied to attention.
zh: 注意力分数算术则不同。仍然有 32 个查询头产生 32 个注意力输出。共享 K/V 头不会删除那些查询头计算。它主要减少 K/V 投影多重性、缓存容量以及需要提供注意力的不同缓存 K/V 数据量。
